calls.title: KBX + GrowthBook
calls.summary: KBX Logistics is assessing feature flagging tools to replace LaunchDarkly, aiming to reduce annual costs while maintaining functionalities like SSO and security. They currently utilize basic Boolean flags across four environments, with a stringent decision deadline set for September 1st. GrowthBook was highlighted for its competitive pricing, open-source model, and support for enterprise features, offering significant advantages over competitors. The discussion also included the importance of migration support, flag management capabilities, and SLAs for uptime and security. A follow-up demo was scheduled to explore these aspects further and solidify the potential fit between GrowthBook and KBX's needs.
calls.keywords: Feature Flagging, LaunchDarkly, GrowthBook, Pricing Model, Role-Based Access, Enterprise SaaS

calls.title: KBX + GrowthBook Demo
calls.summary: The team assessed GrowthBook's feature flagging capabilities as a replacement for LaunchDarkly, analyzing its layered controls for targeted releases, A/B testing, and flag management. Key points included its seat-based pricing model that supports both cloud and self-hosted deployments. Integration capabilities with major cloud data warehouses were highlighted, along with comprehensive support offerings providing 24/7 availability for enterprise customers. Concerns regarding the migration process from LaunchDarkly, including cost reduction and maintaining essential features, were emphasized. Participants expressed the need for streamlined automation in flag management, emphasizing the importance of visibility and operational control in the transition.
calls.keywords: Feature Flags, Experimentation, User Management, Webhooks, Pricing Model, Cloud vs Self-hosting

calls.title: KBX + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The meeting discussed a phased migration from LaunchDarkly to GrowthBook to minimize disruption, starting with one team while maintaining dual SDKs. Migration will include scripts and API token usage, encouraging cleanup of unused flags to simplify the process. GrowthBook's pricing is proposed at under $100k annually for 60 users, with a clear seat-based model and no hidden fees. The decision on the feature flag tool is expected by September 1st due to pricing pressures. GrowthBook supports critical features like Boolean flags and SSO. Comprehensive support and onboarding will be provided at no additional cost, ensuring efficient migration despite identified internal coordination challenges.
calls.keywords: feature flag migration, pricing model, seat-based licensing, LaunchDarkly alternative, migration process, platform fee
